whoFor: Organisations launching a product, entering a market or checking assumptions before they commit money.

benefits.title: Know your market
benefits.text: Size, segments and customer needs, set out from sources you can check.

benefits.title: See your competitors clearly
benefits.text: Who they are, how they position themselves and where the gaps are.

benefits.title: Decide with confidence
benefits.text: Findings framed around the decision you need to make.

whatYouReceive: A research brief agreed with you before work starts
A written report with sources listed
A summary of implications and options
whatYouProvide: The decision the research should support
What you already know about your customers and market
Contacts for any interviews you approve
doesNotInclude: Research methods you have not approved, such as contacting your customers without consent
